query: INSERT INTO daily_lang_stats (study_day, course, reviews, seconds, answered, passed, created_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7) ON CONFLICT (study_day, course) DO UPDATE SET reviews = excluded.reviews, seconds = excluded.seconds, answered = excluded.answered, passed = excluded.passed WHERE daily_lang_stats.reviews IS NOT excluded.reviews OR daily_lang_stats.seconds IS NOT excluded.seconds OR daily_lang_stats.answered IS NOT excluded.answered OR daily_lang_stats.passed IS NOT excluded.passed
